notes: Multi-attacker box. Primary = Mega Kangaskhan ex (megaEx=3-prize, 300HP, CCC colorless). Toolbox ex accessed via Cyrano/Crispin; 1-of rainbow energy (G4/D2/P2/W1/F1/R1)+Prism2 routed by Crispin. All 21 Pokemon are Basic (no evolution). Probe-verified via cg-lib self-play.

expected_dmg.formula: 100 to any 1 target (display=0; ignore W/R on bench)
20 + 20*(my_bench + opp_bench); observed up to 340 at 8+8 bench
200 + (120 if a Pokemon of mine was KO'd by attack last opp turn else 0) => 320
20 + (90 if opp active is Pokemon-ex else 0) => 110 vs ex
100 active; if shuffle 3 energy from self into deck, also 120 to 1 opp bench
120, then return 1 energy from self to hand (self de-energize)
200 fixed; self locked out of attacking next turn

early.on_plan: Kangaskhan-or-viable-starter active by T2; Meowth Last-Ditch fetched a supporter; Area Zero down; Run Errand firing; bench_size>=2

mid.on_plan: Rapid-Fire (200+) lands every turn (nonattacking_turn_rate~0); Hero's Cape on 756; Crispin routes 1-of type energy to the tech attacker that needs it, not to 756

late.on_plan: Boss gusts backline threat/low-HP to close; tech real-damage (Cruel Arrow 100 / Irritated Outburst / Orichalcum 320) delivers lethal; deckCount kept >5 (no deckout)

doctrines.name: Kangaskhan-tank
doctrines.plan: Commit energy to Mega Kangaskhan ex, equip Hero's Cape (->400HP), 2-3HKO with Rapid-Fire while surviving; tech only as answers; keep 2nd Kangaskhan hidden until loaded.
doctrines.discriminating_metric: energy_attach_share[756] high (>0.5) & play_rate[756]~0.95 & most prizes taken by 756

doctrines.name: Toolbox-flex
doctrines.plan: Pick best attacker per matchup: Moltres 110 vs ex-heavy, Fezandipiti Cruel Arrow snipe, Clefairy Rondo under Area Zero 8-bench, Koraidon 320 revenge, Pecharunt Outburst finisher; energy distributed via Crispin.
doctrines.discriminating_metric: energy_attach_share distributed across tech cids & play_rate[140,272,791,979] each >0.15 & first_attack_turn varies by opponent

tensions.balance: Run Errand + Ultra Ball allowed while deckCount>8; suppress both when deckCount<=8
bench_size>5 only while Tera-in-play>=1 (Wellspring/Teal/Koraidon); else Area Zero discards bench to 5
do not expose two Mega Kangaskhan simultaneously until 2nd is loaded and Cape is placed (3-prize x2 = instant loss)
1-of type energy (W/F/R) + Crispin fetch -> tech attacker in play; only route to 756(colorless) when no matching tech is on board

hypotheses.claim: L0 fires self-harm abilities/attacks without a board gate: Pecharunt Subjugating Chains (forced switch + self-poison), Chien-Pao Snow Sink (discards our own Area Zero), or Meowth Tuck Tail (bounces our own Pokemon+energy).
hypotheses.direction: these self-harm triggers must be near-0 unless the declared board condition holds; must never fire with only 1 Pokemon in play (Tuck Tail) or when our own Area Zero is the only stadium (Snow Sink)
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: over-blocking Subjugating Chains removes a legit dark-pivot; over-blocking Tuck Tail removes energy-recycle line
hypotheses.scenario: Reach a board where Meowth ex is the last remaining Pokemon (all bench KO'd); L0 sees Tuck Tail as a 60-dmg attack and selects it -> Meowth returns to hand -> no Pokemon in play -> immediate loss. Alt: our Area Zero in play, a Chien-Pao is played to bench, Snow Sink discards it, Tera later leaves -> forced bench discard.

hypotheses.claim: Display-0/low scale attacks (Fezandipiti Cruel Arrow=0, Pecharunt Irritated Outburst=0, Full Moon Rondo=20, Myriad=30, Orichalcum 200 hides +120) are undervalued: L0 never selects them and never gusts while they are active (gust gate is display>=60).
hypotheses.direction: when a tech attacker's real damage is lethal/highest, its play_rate and gust support must be non-zero; expected_dmg must use the real formula, not display
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: forcing tech attackers into matchups where Kangaskhan is simply better wastes tempo/energy
hypotheses.pattern: scale attack -> real-damage into shared perception

hypotheses.claim: Energy is misrouted: L0 attaches 1-of type energy (W/F/R) and Crispin-fetched types to Kangaskhan (CCC, accepts anything) instead of the tech attacker that requires that exact type, causing permanent type-death of Chien-Pao(WW)/Koraidon(FF)/Wellspring(W).
hypotheses.metric: energy_attach_share[756] vs [209,979,108] , play_rate of type-locked tech
hypotheses.direction: 1-of type energy share to 756 must stay low when a type-matching tech attacker is in play and being set up

threshold.value: type-energy-to-756 share <=0.3 when matching tech present

hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: starving Kangaskhan of energy delays the primary win condition; only reserve when tech is actually online

hypotheses.claim: The 3-prize Mega Kangaskhan is traded loosely: exposed without Hero's Cape, or a 2nd (unloaded) Kangaskhan promoted after KO, letting the opponent take 3 prizes twice and win in 2 KOs.
hypotheses.direction: loss_share[prize] must not dominate; Hero's Cape play_rate on 756 must be high; post-KO promotion must prefer a loaded body
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: refusing to attack until Cape is drawn stalls the game and risks deckout/tempo loss
hypotheses.scenario: Opp gusts a benched 2nd Mega Kangaskhan with 0 energy and no Cape, KOs both Kangaskhan across two turns -> 6 prizes -> loss.

hypotheses.claim: Bench-scaling Full Moon Rondo / Myriad Leaf Shower are never built even when Area Zero enables an 8-wide bench that pushes Rondo to 340, because L0 reads display 20/30.
hypotheses.direction: when bench_total is large and P/G energy available, Clefairy/Teal play_rate must rise; expected_dmg reflects bench count
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: building a wide bench purely for Rondo over-exposes to gust and Area Zero collapse (tension #2/#3)
hypotheses.pattern: scale attack -> real-damage into shared perception

hypotheses.claim: Boss's Orders (4-of) is wasted: gusted too early (my_prizes still high, no valuable back target) or not fired when a tech attacker with display~0 is active despite lethal real damage.
hypotheses.direction: gust must target the prize-optimal / real-lethal body and be reserved for closing turns

threshold.value: boss fired mostly when my_prizes<=4 and target improves prize EV

hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: over-gating Boss loses the early tempo swing of KOing a key setup piece

hypotheses.claim: Deckout: Run Errand (2/turn) + Ultra Ball (dig+discard) thin a Basic-only 60 fast; if the deck stalls (Rapid-Fire whiffs to 200, cannot KO through a wall) it decks out. Probe: random self-play reached deckCount=0 in the majority of games.
hypotheses.direction: loss_share[deckout] must stay low; digging (Run Errand/Ultra Ball) must taper when deckCount is low
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: stopping draw too early starves the toolbox of the exact answer needed and loses on board

hypotheses.claim: Area Zero self-collapse / retreat thrash: L0 over-benches past 5 with non-Tera Pokemon then loses its only Tera (1-of Wellspring/Teal/Koraidon), forcing bench discard; or Latias Skyliner (free retreat) causes excessive pivoting.
hypotheses.direction: bench>5 must coincide with Tera-in-play; area_zero forced-discard of our own bench must be ~0
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: capping bench at 5 forfeits the Rondo scaling payoff of Area Zero

hypotheses.claim: Ultra Ball fires unconditionally and discards irreplaceable 1-of resources (W/F/R energy, single-copy tech ex, Hero's Cape) as its 2-card cost.
hypotheses.direction: Ultra Ball must only fire when 2 genuinely surplus cards are discardable

threshold.value: no 1-of key card discarded to Ultra Ball

hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: never using Ultra Ball cripples the search/consistency engine

hypotheses.claim: Koraidon Orichalcum Fang (display 200) misses its +120 revenge window (=320) because L0 does not know the conditional; the after-KO lethal turn is skipped or mis-attacked.
hypotheses.direction: when a Pokemon of ours was KO'd last turn and Koraidon is loaded, Orichalcum should be valued at 320
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: over-valuing Koraidon commits scarce F energy to a 1-of tech instead of the primary
hypotheses.pattern: scale attack -> real-damage into shared perception
